title: Baseline log redirection needs a worktree evidence directory
body: The first baseline configure invocation failed before the box queue ran because shell redirection targeted .tmp/baseline-configure.log while .tmp did not exist (exit 1: No such file or directory). I created the directory with mkdir -p .tmp and reran the same queued configure. A lane evidence helper could create its output directory before invoking the command.

title: Windowed capture script should canonicalize its output directory
body: The baseline command passed relative capture root .tmp/captures-before to tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh. The script creates .tmp/captures-before/hud from the repo-root CWD, then starts apps with CWD build/wsl/binaries; their relative VIXEN_*_CAPTURE_DIR paths therefore point at a missing directory and stbi_write_png fails. Retrying with an absolute capture root inside the same worktree resolves it. The script already canonicalizes its runtime directories; it should canonicalize capture_root too.

title: The VIXEN build invocation needs a canonical repository-root working directory
body: The queued command ran from the nested VIXEN source directory with the user-specified relative path build/wsl, but this worktree's configured build tree is at the repository root, so cmake failed before compilation with: Error: /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/editorbase/VIXEN/build/wsl is not a directory (exit 1; queue log 1791408956-build-editorbase:impl-build1.log). Rerunning the same queued build from the repository root with build/wsl resolves it. A lane build helper should anchor relative build paths to the configured repository root.

title: Pin VIXEN AppFlow schema catalogue to the build wave
body: The default queued build command cmake --build build/wsl --parallel 4 failed at ALL target appflow_check with exit 1; see queue log 1791409003-build-editorbase:impl-build2.log. Its CodegenTool --check consumed /home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json, whose timestamp 2026-10-08 00:06:53 is newer than the successful VIXEN stamp at 00:02:17, and rejected Undertow.Content.Core.Systems.Diplomacy.Leveraged index Source as not unique with owner visibility. The baseline default build passed at 00:02:30. A fresh queued build of vixen_editor and test_editor_document_model_preview passed without bypassing a gate. Pin the schema catalogue to the same wave or scope AppFlow validation to its declared references so a concurrent external catalogue update does not turn this editor build red.

title: Provide image dependencies for the visual lane measurement environment
body: The bible measurement command using PIL and numpy failed with ModuleNotFoundError for PIL, and numpy was also absent. I installed binary wheels locally with python3 -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --target .tmp/visual-python Pillow numpy, then could run the required frame measurements and contact sheet generation. Provide these packages or a small standard visual helper so visual witnesses do not need lane-local package provisioning.

title: Restore the documented content codegen helper to the VIXEN worktree
body: The mandated queued light gate command bash tools/check-content-codegen.sh exited 127 because the script is absent from both tools/ and VIXEN/tools/ in this lane worktree. I used the documented CMake codegen targets from VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt as the supported fallback; their checks were current except appflow_check, which fails on the newer external Undertow schema catalogue. Include the helper in the lane checkout or update the worker brief to name the supported target command.

title: Isolate legacy shading overrides in visual capture runs
body: The editor capture stopped passing VIXEN_TEST_CELSHADE_LAMBERT_GGX, but an inherited shell value still overrides the shared graph default. I added env -u for every app invocation in tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh so the editor capture measures the declared cel default. A capture runner should isolate render-mode overrides per app instead of inheriting ambient test variables.
